test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

If U + V ÷ W – X × Y, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: U is Y’s husband’s mother’s brother.
W, X and Y are sisters.
V is the father of X’s mother.
Y is the wife of W.

solution:

Given: U + V ÷ W – X × Y

It means: U is the Brother of V, V is the Sister of W, W is the Mother of X, X is the Husband of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18bc43f40f306fedc66d3f71a49f778e230e35a833634c03fbe6e0160925fa03.png] 

Option 1) U is Y’s husband’s mother’s brother - **True**.

Option 2) W, X and Y are sisters - False.

Option 3) V is the father of X’s mother - False.

Option 4) Y is the wife of W - False.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
